title: Wilson-loop cover and its seven incident anchor stars
caption: Presentation only; no admission weight. The cover R={0,e_z} (two coarse factors), the four links of the original xz Wilson loop W at the fine origin drawn thick, and the seven incident anchor stars b+S, S={0,e_x,e_y,e_z}, at R-S={0,-e_x,-e_y,-e_z,e_z,e_z-e_x,e_z-e_y}. title: Window kernel vs Poisson kernel at s=1
caption: Presentation only; no admission weight. (a) The Poisson kernel s/(π(s²+θ²)) and the window transform modulus |ġ(θ)|=(4s³/π)(s²+θ²)⁻², log-log. (b) The first-moment integrands |θ|·kernel: the Poisson 1/θ tail (log-divergent integral) versus the window's θ⁻³ decay, annotated with M₀=2, M₁=4s/π.

title: Round32 error-budget previews at τ=1e-8, s=1
caption: Presentation only; no admission weight. A horizontal dot chart (log x-axis) comparing four planning-notes error-budget previews against the 1e-6 target: AT4 Poisson L=1e4 (state 8.08e-4, centering 6.5e-7, dynamics 7.2e-7, tail 3.2e-5); the optimized Poisson floor (1.187e-6 bulk + 7.8e-8 tail, state suppressed); window + crude tier D=2.37e-5 (state 2D, dynamics 1.56e-7); window + exact tier D≈1.4e-8 (state 2D, dynamics 1.56e-7).
